sources.title: Introducing Laguna S 2.1 - poolside.ai
sources.snippet: Today we're releasing Laguna S 2.1, a significant step forward in our development of models that pursue longer horizon work and make effective use of reasoning. Laguna S 2.1 is a 118B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 8B activated parameters per token and supports a context window of up to 1M tokens in thinking and no-thinking modes. sources.title: Laguna S-2.1 (poolside) — NVFP4 on 1× DGX Spark (GB10)
sources.snippet: Laguna S-2.1 requires vLLM ≥ 0.25.0 (per poolside's model card — and confirmed the hard way). On older vLLM builds that "support Laguna" (e.g. the community AEON images at 0.23/0.24, which serve Laguna XS 2.1 fine): plain chat works and looks healthy, but the moment you attach tools, the model emits pure token salad (Chic isp callbackokrping# horses…) and tool_calls never parse.
